procedure.targets: the official validation targets; held-out trials are not built
procedure.references: batch predictions regenerated in memory from the frozen Ridge decoder, the three GRU checkpoints, and the official recursive Kalman validation path
procedure.replay: every unit's spikes merged in time order and revealed only once the 10 ms behavior clock has passed them; the buffer is emptied at each trial start and holds only spikes a later window can use
procedure.kalman: the official filter runs unchanged on 50 ms intervals counted from the same replay and is instrumented to record every step and update

latency.procedure: per target in timestamp order with trial resets, after the untimed verification replay; models loaded and every input in memory, no file I/O; time.perf_counter_ns with garbage collection paused; each model is timed on the second of two consecutive passes, the first discarded as warm-up. Preprocessing reveals the spikes that arrived since the previous 10 ms step, discards expired ones, and counts the model's window (Ridge and GRU also normalize it; the GRU copies it to the device). Inference returns the velocity in cm/s (GRU: forward pass and copy back to the host; Kalman: one 10 ms filter step, including any scheduled update).
